title: BlendOps Canonical Typed Runtime Operations Registry

governance_summary.external_runtime_ownership: BlendOps does not own or ship a Blender runtime, MCP server, or Blender add-on. External runtimes (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+ and Path 2 Community mcp-for-blender 3.0+) own Blender execution; BlendOps governs typed operation planning, capability preflight, pre-mutation .blend checkpoints, independent readback, and truthful evidence.
governance_summary.capability_tier_distinction: Every BlendOps skill operates at capabilityTier = L0 (planning/validation content layer), while governedRuntimeCeiling (L0-L3) bounds the maximum external runtime operation tier that skill may authorize.

blocked_arbitrary_interfaces.reason: Unrestricted Python or raw bpy code passthrough (including raw user-facing execute_blender_code prompts) is prohibited as a BlendOps operation.
Arbitrary shell commands and unvalidated CLI flags cannot be invoked through the typed runtime operation surface.
Destructive multi-object deletion, arbitrary filesystem writes outside allowlisted directories, and unbacked scene resets are blocked.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Uses Path 2 import_asset only after SPDX/category license clearance and .blend backup.
path-2-community.qualification_evidence: Upstream tool import_asset exists in MCP for Blender (ahujasid/mcp-for-blender) v2.2.7 (https://github.com/ahujasid/blender-mcp/blob/main/src/blender_mcp/server.py#L1951) but performs unbounded external network download and scene mutation without local SHA-256/license enforcement; blocked on real upstream unless governed contract extension is active.

required_preconditions.description: Asset must carry Cleared license status from asset-license-checker.
Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist and be SHA-256 verified on disk.

required_postconditions.description: Independent scene readback confirms the imported asset datablock exists in the scene.

known_limitations: External asset import tool (import_asset) is only exposed on Path 2 community mcp-for-blender and remains gated at L2.

path-1-official-blender-lab-mcp.upstream_security_warning: Official Blender Lab MCP documentation explicitly warns that execute_blender_code and execute_blender_code_for_cli execute LLM-generated Python inside Blender without built-in guards protecting user data.

real_upstream_qualification_summary.mutation_blocking_reason: Upstream blender-mcp v1.0.2 (commit dbbf836ad4b1025f14a2b3b504c43903f39e0b04) provides zero dedicated bounded L1 scene-mutation tools; all scene mutations upstream rely on execute_blender_code (unsafe_raw_code), and render_viewport_to_path / render_thumbnail_to_path are classified as conditional due to open upstream issues #12 and #70.

path-2-community-mcp-for-blender.upstream_security_warning: Third-party community integration (not affiliated with Blender Foundation). Exposes execute_blender_code which runs arbitrary Python via exec() in Blender without sandboxing, plus cloud asset/3D generation tools.

real_upstream_qualification_summary.mutation_blocking_reason: Upstream mcp-for-blender v2.2.7 (commit 2e4b0bc294694b1570d76ed01be657c22e6d02a0) provides zero dedicated bounded L1 scene-mutation tools or local L2 GLB/render export tools; mutations rely on execute_blender_code (unsafe_raw_code) and import_asset downloads unverified remote assets.

upstream_tool_qualification_matrix.description: Render a small, low-quality thumbnail to output_path (temporarily overrides settings).
upstream_tool_qualification_matrix.output_shape_summary: dict confirming thumbnail file written to output_path
upstream_tool_qualification_matrix.qualification_rationale: Upstream sets readOnlyHint=True, but open upstream issue #70 shows INVOKE_DEFAULT restores temporary resolution/simplify/sample overrides before interactive rendering starts, and issue #12 shows scene.render.filepath is mutated directly on the user scene until the deferred callback finishes while forcing output into os.path.join(bpy.app.tempdir, 'blender_mcp', basename). Reclassified as conditional: blocked in unguarded live mode unless disposableSceneConfirmed + verified .blend checkpoint + isolated governed staging directory + pre/post render settings readback restoration check pass.
